headings.instruction: Use for all module titles, panel headers, and large metric numbers. Apply uppercase for section headers.

body.instruction: Left-align dense content. Use for descriptions, lists, standard buttons, and input fields.

data_points.instruction: Use tabular-nums for all live counters, statistics, and IDs to prevent layout shift during live updates.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: Use p-4 to p-8 inside cards. For touch targets (mobile), min height must be 44px (h-11 or h-12).
layout_and_spacing.home_page: Implement a staggered bento grid for the 9 panels. Break perfect symmetry. For example, Yönetim and Canlı Pano can take col-span-2 or row-span-2. Provide 'breathing room' between cards (gap-4 or gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.tv_dashboard: Scale typography fluidly (e.g., text-[4vw] to text-[8vw]) so it spans the factory floor. Maximize contrast. Use massive spacing (p-12, gap-8) to separate data zones.

cards.classes: panel-industrial bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFBF00] text-black font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,191,0,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(255,191,0,0.5)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white border border-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-3

inputs.style: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFBF00]/50 focus:border-[#FFBF00] text-white p-3 h-11

motion_and_animations.entrance: Staggered fade-slide-up for grid items. Implement using framer-motion with variants { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } } and staggerChildren.
motion_and_animations.live_indicators: Pulse animations for active machine statuses and 'Canlı Pano' live dots.
motion_and_animations.interactions: Scale down slightly on click (`active:scale-95`). Icons bounce slightly on hover.
motion_and_animations.lite_mode_handling: Detect existing `lite-mode` state. If active, set framer-motion transitions to 0s duration or disable them completely. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

media.preservation_rules: CRITICAL: MUST PRESERVE Atatürk portrait (top-left) and waving Turkish flag (top-right) exactly as they are on the Home page.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark metallic wavy background. Use as a very low-opacity (10-15%) overlay for the TV Dashboard (Canlı Pano) or high-impact hero headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not remove or alter any `data-testid` attributes.
Zero functionality changes allowed. All data mapping, API calls, and logic must remain exactly as is.
Refactor the Home page to use an asymmetrical Bento grid layout instead of basic equal columns. Highlight 'Canlı Pano' and 'Yönetim' with larger spans.
Enhance the 'Industrial Glass' aesthetic by refining `.panel-industrial` borders and shadows in Tailwind.
Ensure touch targets are universally min 44px for gloved factory operators on tablets.
Maximize contrast and scale for Canlı Pano (TV mode) so it's readable from a distance.
Apply Framer Motion staggered entrance animations but handle the 'lite mode' graceful degradation correctly.
